info.description: REST API for the JAT job application tracker. The API requires the X-Jat-Client-Type header on all routes (values: web-client, tui-client). Web clients use HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Strict cookies; TUI clients receive tokens in the JSON response.
info.title: Job Application Tracker (JAT) API

get.description: Admin-only endpoint to grant (GET) or revoke (DELETE) admin privileges for a user.
Returns all application statuses belonging to the authenticated user.

post.description: Creates a new application status for the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns a single application status. Users can read their own; admins can read any.

put.description: Updates an existing application status. Only the owner or an admin can update it.

delete.description: Deletes an application status. If soft_delete=true, performs a soft delete (and cascades to linked job applications). Otherwise archives the status. Only the owner or an admin can delete it.

parameters.description: Soft deletes the application status, if set to false it archives the status instead
parameters.name: soft_delete

put.description: Restores an archived application status. Only the owner or an admin can unarchive it.

post.description: Authenticates a user. For web clients the response includes two Set-Cookie headers: access_token (HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict; Path=/api; Max-Age=300) and refresh_token (HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict; Path=/api/auth; Max-Age=5184000). TUI clients receive the tokens in the response body. The X-Jat-Client-Type header is required by the server middleware but is set automatically by the generated web client.

Set-Cookie.description: access_token=<jwt>; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict; Path=/api; Max-Age=300 AND refresh_token=<token>; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict; Path=/api/auth; Max-Age=5184000

post.description: Revokes the current refresh token. For web clients the refresh_token cookie is cleared by setting Max-Age=-1 on the response. The X-Jat-Client-Type header is required by the server middleware but is set automatically by the generated web client.

Set-Cookie.description: refresh_token=; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict; Path=/api/auth; Max-Age=-1

get.description: Issues a new access token from a valid refresh token. Web clients get a new access_token cookie (path /api, MaxAge=300); TUI clients get the token in the response body. The X-Jat-Client-Type header is required by the server middleware but is set automatically by the generated web client.

Set-Cookie.description: access_token=<jwt>; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict; Path=/api; Max-Age=300

get.description: Revokes the refresh token passed in the request. For web clients the refresh_token cookie is cleared by setting Max-Age=-1 on the response. The X-Jat-Client-Type header is required by the server middleware but is set automatically by the generated web client.

Set-Cookie.description: refresh_token=; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict; Path=/api/auth; Max-Age=-1

get.description: Returns every company in the system. (returns 403 if a non admin user passes the preload_users query param)

parameters.description: Include a count of user applications for this company
parameters.name: user_count

parameters.description: Include user data for the creation/edits of companies (admin only)
parameters.name: preload_users

parameters.description: Include a count of total applications (global) for this company
parameters.name: total_count

get.description: Returns a single company by ID.

parameters.description: Include a count of user applications for this company
parameters.name: user_count

parameters.description: Include a count of total applications (global) for this company
parameters.name: total_count

delete.description: Admin-only. Soft-deletes a company by ID.

get.description: Counts the Job Applications a company has company ID. If the total_count query param is true it returns the total applications for a company, otherwise it returns the total applications for the user

parameters.description: Include a count of total applications (global) for this company
parameters.name: total_count

get.description: Returns the history of changes to a company record (admin only)
get.summary: Get history of changes to a company

put.description: Reverts a change that was made to a company record (admin only)

get.description: Returns a success message if the database is reachable.
Returns whether the server has been initialized (first admin created). This is used by the web UI to decide between the create-account and login flows.
Sets the server initialized flag. Only the first admin can call this.
Returns all job applications belonging to the authenticated user.

post.description: Creates a new job application for the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns a single job application. Users can read their own; admins can read any.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a job application. Only the owner or an admin can delete it.

get.description: Returns the status change history for a single job application. Users can read their own; admins can read any.
Returns all notes belonging to a specific job application.
get.summary: List notes for a job application

post.description: Adds a note to a job application.

get.description: Returns a single note from a job application.

put.description: Updates an existing note on a job application.

delete.description: Deletes a note from a job application.

put.description: Changes the status of a job application.

get.description: Admin-only endpoint that returns every user.

post.description: Creates the first user. If no admin exists and the service is not initialized, the new user becomes the first admin.

put.description: Changes the default application status of an individual user

parameters.description: ID of the new Default Application Status
parameters.name: request

get.description: Returns the currently authenticated user. This is the only user endpoint that web clients can call on page load without knowing their own UUID.
Gives statistics related to a user
